जबारु जबारु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. जव?), Ved.
hastening, speedy.

जबाल जबाल, अस्, m., N. of a man; (आ),
f., N. of a woman.

जाबाल 1. जाबाल, अस्, m. (fr. जबाला), a
metronymic of Mahā-śāla; also of Satya-kāma; the
author of a law-book; also of a medicinal work;
(आस्), m. pl., N. of a school of the Yajur-veda.
—जा-
बालोपनिषद् (˚ल-उप्˚), त्, f., N. of an Upaniṣad
belonging to the Atharva-veda.

जाबाल 2. जाबाल, अस्, m. (a corruption of
अजा-पाल), a goat-herd.

जब्धृ, धा, ध्री, धृ, snatching at, seizing
with the mouth.
जाबालायन, अस्, m., N. of a preceptor.

जाबालि, इस्, m., N. of an ancient sage; also of the
author of a law-book; N. of an infidel Brāhman who
was one of the priests of king Daśa-ratha and after
his death tried ineffectually to shake the resolution
of Rāma and induce him to take the throne offered
to him by his dutiful younger brother Bharata; (his
speech, which is given in Rāmāyaṇa

, con-
tains doctrines very similar to those of the Cārvākas
or materialists.)
जाबालिन्, इनस्, m. pl., N. of a school.
